tagline: Istanbul's most coveted Bosphorus address — upscale, leafy, and home to the city's best coffee culture alongside stunning waterfront dining.

items.name: Starbucks Bebek
items.description: Yes, a Starbucks — but the Bebek branch is genuinely one of the most beautiful coffee spots in the city. Right on the Bosphorus with an incredible terrace.
items.tip: Go for the view, not the coffee. The terrace at sunset is breathtaking. Arrive 30 min before to secure a waterfront seat.

items.name: Bebek Kahve
items.description: A neighbourhood institution. Traditional Turkish coffee and tea in a relaxed setting. The place locals actually go.
items.tip: Order Turkish tea (çay) and sit outside. This is the Bebek experience at its most authentic.

items.name: Kronotrop Bebek
items.description: Excellent specialty coffee in a bright, airy space. Good for working from or a slow morning.

items.name: Bebek Balıkçısı
items.description: One of Istanbul's most respected fish restaurants. Exceptional quality, beautiful Bosphorus setting, and service to match.
items.tip: Book a week ahead for weekends. The whole turbot is the dish to order when in season.

items.name: Bebek Burger
items.description: A beloved local burger joint that Bebek residents have been devoted to for years. Simple, excellent, unfussy.
items.tip: Queue at lunchtime is normal and moves fast. The classic cheeseburger is the order.

items.name: Lucca Bebek
items.description: A popular café-restaurant with outdoor seating and a reliable all-day menu. Good for weekend brunch with a view.

items.name: Bebek Park & Promenade
items.description: A beautiful waterfront park and walking path along the Bosphorus. One of the city's most pleasant morning walk spots.

items.name: Boğaziçi University Campus
items.description: One of Turkey's most beautiful university campuses, set on a hillside above Bebek with stunning Bosphorus views. Open to visitors.
items.tip: Walk up through the campus for views that most visitors never see. Free to enter.

items.name: Rumeli Hisarı (Fortress)
items.description: A 15th-century Ottoman fortress overlooking the narrowest point of the Bosphorus — just north of Bebek. Excellent views.
items.tip: Open most days. The walk from Bebek along the waterfront takes about 20 minutes.

tips: Bebek is best reached by bus from Beşiktaş (25E) or by taxi. No metro access.
The waterfront fills up fast on weekend afternoons. Weekday mornings are dramatically more peaceful.
The walk from Bebek to Arnavutköy (south) or Rumeli Hisarı (north) are both excellent and worth doing.
Parking is extremely limited. Don't try to drive on weekends.
